svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.28.4.5 Application of Stucco Lath
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.28 STUCCO

g.text: Stucco lath at an external corner
Dark bands: laps, 50 mm (1 15/16″) or more (2)
150 mm (5⅞″) or more, from the corner

svg.text: Stucco lath is applied with the long dimension
Horizontal and vertical joints in stucco lath
are lapped not less than 50 mm (1 15/16″).
End joints of stucco lath are staggered and
External corners of stucco lath are reinforced
with a vertical strip of lath or reinforcing
extending not less than 150 mm (5⅞″) on both
sides of the corner, or the lath or
reinforcing extends around corners not less
Sheet sizes are schematic, laps drawn at the 50 mm minimum. A shows the second option of (4), C shows both. Backing drawn as sheathing.
